title: Imagery shows N.Korea may soon launch new missile submarine — Nasdaq/Reuters (SI Analytics)
snippet: SI Analytics satellite imagery from March 20 and March 26 shows increased vehicle activity and covers removed from the Hero Kim Gun Ok SLBM submarine at Sinpo South Shipyard, North Korea. The think tank assesses preparations consistent with imminent launch or sea trials. The submarine is believed capable of carrying multiple submarine-launched ballistic missiles.
